SmartRain provides smart irrigation services. It is based on IOT domain. The SmartRain smart watering system is an innovative solution for watering properties. It uses sophisticated technology to monitor local weather conditions and soil moisture levels, and automatically adjusts the amount of water it applies to each area accordingly. This eliminates the need for manual adjustments, saving time and money while conserving water.
Involved in Architecture Discussions, Technical Discussions and Information gathering
Integrated Redis ,Kafka and various third-party libraries and Part of the Deployment Process
Tech Stack - Java 11 | Spring Boot 3 | MYSQL | Angular | GIT
Smartrain Technology Services Pvt Ltd (07/2022 - Present)

A Senior Software Engineer with over 7 years of experience as a Java Full Stack Developer. I hold a Master's in Computer Application from NIT Jamshedpur. My expertise includes designing and implementing sophisticated web applications using Spring Boot, Microservices, and various database technologies.

Rubicon is the USA’s fastest growing time tracking application which takes the customers from Netsuite and provides them services ie, snow removal, grass cutting and many others. Once the service request came to Rubicon, it assigned a sales rep and labour to provide service and monitor the work. After completion of work, it generates a report of work and submits to the Netsuite which will be responsible for billing and payment.
Worked independently on modules and collaboratively on projects
Maintained technical documentation for code, APIs
Involved in integration of Springboot with Netsuite using REST API .
Tech Stack - Java 8 | Spring Boot | Postgres

My LawnButler application provides services for Landscaping, Snow Removal, Water Management, and Tree care. Led the design and development of a high-end commercial landscape project for a residential community in Utah, focused on enhancing the aesthetic and functional integration between outdoor spaces and building architecture. Collaborated with Lawn Butler’s professional design team to conceptualise, plan, and implement a comprehensive landscape solution tailored to the client’s vision.
Implemented Design patterns to reuse the code.  Integrated JUnit test cases for Backend API
Involved in integration of Backend API with Frontend Engineers.
